title: Base Substitution Analysis and Redox-State Framework
summary: This cluster revolves around the analysis of base substitutions in genomes, specifically involving methods such as Genome-Wide Base Substitution Analysis and tools like Mutect2 and WRS analysis. The analysis is associated with various chemical substitutions, including C > A, C > G, C > T, and others. The cluster also explores the relationship between base substitutions and redox-state, with Low DO and High DO being enriched in detoxification and oxidoreductase activity, respectively. Additionally, the cluster touches on the concept of ROS pressure and its impact on the transcriptome-fidelity response model, which is equivalent to the Inferred redox-state framework.
